places.quote: I first become aware of myself down in Essex, a thieving turnips for my living.
I had come out of Kingston Jail last on a vagrancy committal.
places.note: Historically in Surrey, outside London; now within Greater London.

places.quote: At Epsom races, a matter of over twenty years ago, I got acquainted wi' a man
places.note: The booth 'on the heath' is at Epsom Downs; the race venue is the setting.

places.quote: Arthur lived at the top of Compeyson's house (over nigh Brentford it was)
places.note: Western edge of London in Dickens's day, historically Middlesex; boundary unclear.

places.quote: A deserting soldier in a Traveller's Rest, what lay hid up to the chin under a lot of taturs
places.note: Probably a generic inn name; cannot be located.
